title: Tele Medicine Platform
seo_title: Tele Medicine Platform | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Security architecture you can evidence — for humans, machines and models.

blocks.x: AI-driven remote evaluation, diagnosis and treatment — one platform for virtual care at scale.

Tele Medicine Platform unifies our security delivery: zero-trust enforcement points (identity, posture, segmentation, workload identity), detection-as-code with ATT&CK coverage, cloud posture guardrails, and the AI-specific layer — prompt-injection defense, agent containment, shadow-AI discovery and model security cards. Sentinel is engineered for the evidence economy: controls mapped across SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-207, DORA and AI regimes, tested continuously, exported to auditors. Boards get measured trust reduction, not adjectives.

blocks.x: Sentinel assumes breach and designs for audit: purple-team validation of segmentation, restore-tested backups, AI red-team suites with findings-to-fix tracking. The platform's own controls are ISO/IEC 27001 audited and ISO 27001 certified.

Tele Medicine Platform runs under NDA in Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Energy & Utilities, Public Sector & Government, Technology & SaaS. Deployments stay private; the architecture and control packs are the part we can show.
Connects to: SIEM/XDR, SPIFFE/SPIRE, OPA, IdPs/IGA, CNAPP tooling. Adapters are versioned and contract-tested, so upgrades stop being incidents.
The next step is small and real: one working session on Tele Medicine Platform, your data, and a written feasibility read you can circulate.
